snippet.title: The Last Salvage Squad Trailer
snippet.description:
The latest installment of the FPS “JFPS,” created by Japanese developers.
A story about robots who continue to fight invaders on Earth after the extinction of humanity!

Released on June 18, 2026.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3551190/

And, Nintendo Switch™ and Nintendo Switch™ 2 version will also be released at the same time!
